questions.a:
첫째는 협업과 커뮤니케이션 역량입니다. 외장설계는 3D 모델링, 공정 이해, 제품 지식 등 기술적 기반도 중요하지만, 무엇보다 다양한 부서와의 긴밀한 협력이 핵심입니다. 초기 디자인 단계부터 양산 이후까지 디자인, 성능, 생산, 품질, 협력사와 함께 업무를 진행하기 때문에, 각 단계의 요구사항과 이슈를 명확히 이해하고 조율하는 능력이 필수적입니다.

둘째는 도전(Challenge) 정신입니다. GM이 축적해온 기술과 노하우를 기반으로 하되, 빠르게 변화하는 시장 요구와 기술 트렌드에 맞춰 새로운 접근을 시도하는 태도가 필요합니다. 저희 담당에서는 설계 단순화와 최적화 활동(Engineering With Simplicity), 설계 가이드라인 개선 활동(Best Practice Challenge) 등 내부 혁신 프로그램을 통해 새로운 아이디어를 실제 개발에 반영하고 있습니다.

셋째는 문제 해결 능력과 판단력입니다. 외장설계는 개발 과정에서 예기치 못한 이슈가 자주 발생하는 분야입니다. 금형 수정, 검증 결과 이슈, 양산 품질 문제 등 다양한 상황에서 문제의 본질을 빠르게 파악하고 데이터 기반으로 해결책을 제시하는 역량이 중요합니다. 더불어 일정, 품질, 비용을 종합적으로 고려해 최적의 결정을 내리는 판단력 역시 프로젝트를 안정적으로 이끄는 핵심 요소입니다.

셋째는 문제 해결 능력과 판단력입니다. 외장설계는 개발 과정에서 예기치 못한 이슈가 자주 발생하는 분야입니다. 금형 수정, 검증 결과 이슈, 양산 품질 문제 등 다양한 상황에서 문제의 본질을 빠르게 파악하고 데이터 기반으로 해결책을 제시하는 역량이 중요합니다. 더불어 일정, 품질, 비용을 종합적으로 고려해 최적의 결정을 내리는 판단력 역시 프로젝트를 안정적으로 이끄는 핵심 요소입니다.
questions.aEn:
First, collaboration and communication skills are essential. In exterior design, technical foundations such as 3D modeling, process understanding, and product knowledge are important, but close cooperation with many different departments matters even more. From the initial design phase through mass production, we work with Design, Performance, Manufacturing, Quality, and suppliers, so the ability to clearly understand and coordinate the requirements and issues at each stage is critical.

Second, a challenge-driven mindset is required. While we build on GM’s accumulated technologies and know-how, we also need the attitude to try new approaches that respond to rapidly changing market needs and technology trends. In situations such as tool modifications, validation findings, or mass-production quality issues, it is important to quickly grasp the root cause and propose solutions based on data. In addition, the ability to make balanced decisions that consider schedule, quality, and cost is a key factor in leading projects smoothly and reliably.

questions.qEn: Please tell us specifically about your role and responsibilities.
questions.a: 샤시(Chassis) 담당은 차량의 조향, 제동, 승차감, 전체적인 주행 거동과 직접 연결된 부품들을 개발하는 조직입니다. 운전자가 원하는 대로 잘 움직이면서도, 안정적이고 편안한 차를 만드는 역할을 합니다. 그 중 저는 엔진과 모터, 변속기와 같은 파워트레인을 차체에 연결하는 마운트 부품 설계를 담당하고 있습니다. 이 마운트는 주행 중 발생하는 소음과 진동, 힘의 전달을 조절하는 핵심 부품입니다. 제가 맡은 역할은 이 부품을 설계·검증하면서, 차량의 정숙성, 주행 감각, 내구성이 목표 수준을 만족하도록 책임지는 것입니다.

questions.aEn: The Chassis team develops components directly connected to a vehicle’s steering, braking, ride comfort, and overall driving dynamics. In short, we make cars that respond precisely to the driver’s input while remaining stable and comfortable. Within this, I am responsible for designing the mounting components that connect the powertrain—engine, motor, and transmission—to the body. These mounts are key parts that control how noise, vibration, and forces are transmitted during driving. My role is to design and validate these components so that the vehicle’s quietness, driving feel, and durability meet their targeted performance levels.

questions.aEn: Above all, it is essential to think from a system perspective, considering the balance with the entire vehicle rather than just designing individual parts. Although I was still a junior engineer at the time, the support of my senior colleagues helped me truly experience the value of collaboration and made this a defining growth moment in my engineering career.

questions.q: 내게 GMTCK란?
questions.qKr: 내게 GMTCK란?
questions.qEn: What does GMTCK mean to you?
questions.a:
GMTCK는 엔지니어로서의 전문성과 삶의 균형을 동시에 실현해 주는 '든든한 베이스캠프'입니다. 글로벌 프로젝트에 참여하며 서비스 엔지니어링의 풀 패키지 경험을 쌓는 즐거움과 함께, 회사의 배려 깊은 문화 덕분에 일과 가정의 균형을 지키며 성장할 수 있었습니다. 한국 엔지니어링의 경쟁력을 세계에 증명하고, 그 과정에서 실질적인 전문성을 쌓아가는 즐거움을 느끼고 있습니다.

questions.aEn: The Interior Trim team is responsible for most of the interior components that customers see and touch when they get into a vehicle. It consists of four teams—Overhead Systems, Acoustic, Instrument Panel, and Door Trim—and collectively shapes the interior space in terms of design, usability, quietness, and perceived quality. Among these, I am responsible for designing the instrument panel (IP), often called the “centerpiece” of the interior. The IP is the area the driver faces for the longest time and is a key packaging zone where various electrical components and structures—such as safety features, displays, switches, and HVAC systems—are integrated. Based on the styling requirements from the design team, I complete designs that simultaneously satisfy both the visible design and the hidden structural performance, while considering safety, durability, manufacturability, and cost.

questions.qEn: Which capabilities do we need to have for your role?
questions.a:
DRE(Design Release Engineer)는 담당 Part의 Owner로서, 차량 개발의 전 마일스톤을 따라가며 설계–검증–양산까지 책임지는 역할입니다. 일반적인 관행과 사내 표준을 기반으로 합리적인 의사결정을 내려야 하기 때문에, 무엇보다도 높은 책임감이 가장 중요한 역량이라고 생각합니다.
여기에 더해 IP 설계를 위해서는 기본적인 기계·재료공학 지식과 3D CAD를 활용한 설계 능력, 가상 해석 결과를 이해하고 설계에 반영할 수 있는 논리적인 사고가 필요합니다. 생산·품질·구매·설계 협력업체 등 다양한 이해관계자와 함께 일하기 때문에, 상대를 존중하는 커뮤니케이션 능력과 협업 태도도 필수입니다. 하지만 저는 궁극적으로 책임감과 열정만 있다면, 나머지 기술적인 부분은 현업 속에서 충분히 성장해 나갈 수 있다고 생각합니다.

questions.aEn:
As the owner of their assigned parts, a DRE (Design Release Engineer) is responsible for following every vehicle development milestone and taking ownership from design and validation through to mass production. Because they must make sound decisions based on common practices and internal standards, a strong sense of responsibility is the most important capability.

In addition, IP design requires fundamental knowledge of mechanical and materials engineering, the ability to design using 3D CAD, and logical thinking skills to interpret virtual analysis results and reflect them in the design. Since the role involves working with a wide range of stakeholders—such as manufacturing, quality, purchasing, and design suppliers, respectful communication skills and a collaborative attitude are also essential. Ultimately, however, I believe that if someone has responsibility and passion, they can fully develop the technical aspects on the job.

The most impressve projects was the development of the compact car Spark, which I worked on right after joining the company. I was involved in the entire process, from the initial specification review and section layout to 3D data build-up, performance testing, and finally mass production. In particular, we had to overcome numerous technical challenges to maximize customer needs within a limited cost target.

The process of delivering the best possible performance and quality at low cost was far from easy, but by putting our heads together as a team and finding optimal solutions, I was able to firmly build my foundation as a design engineer. Seeing the data on the drawings materialize into a mass-produced vehicle and watching that car drive on the road gave me a sense of thrill and accomplishment that made me realize this work is truly my calling.

리더십 역시 업무 능력뿐 아니라 인성을 갖춘 리더들이 많다고 느낍니다. 팀원 각자의 상황과 커리어 고민을 이해하려고 노력하고, 필요할 때는 앞에서 보호막이 되어 주고, 기회가 있을 때는 팀원들을 대신 내세워 성장할 수 있도록 지원해 줍니다. 이런 환경 덕분에 새로운 도전도 부담보다는 기대감으로 받아들일 수 있고, 자연스럽게 “나도 후배들에게 이런 선배가 되고 싶다”라는 생각을 하게 됩니다.

No one is left to struggle alone with a difficult design issue; the greatest pride of our team is having colleagues who come together as a collective intelligence to find the answer.

questions.aEn:
The Thermal Propulsion Integration design team is responsible for designing and integrating the thermal management architecture that enables optimal performance of the vehicle’s propulsion systems—such as the engine, motor, and battery—as well as the interior heating and cooling system. In addition, our design scope extends to the induction, exhaust, and fuel systems, allowing us to perform integrated design that covers overall powertrain performance, efficiency, and durability, as well as emissions regulations and noise.

Within this, I am specifically in charge of powertrain cooling system design, ensuring that the powertrain maintains stable operation by securing sufficient thermal performance under a wide range of driving conditions. At the same time, I focus on creating a cabin temperature environment that allows customers to drive more comfortably and safely.

The recent C1YX-2 PHEV program. As a PHEV combines the strengths of internal combustion engine vehicles and EVs, it requires far more thermal management components than a conventional ICE vehicle. Based on the system development direction defined in the thermal schematic, I focused on optimizing the package so that all performance requirements could be met within the constraints of the limited vehicle package space.

By reviewing and refining various packaging concepts through CIT, I spent a great deal of time and effort finding the right balance between packaging constraints and performance targets. Because PHEV/HEV projects are still relatively new not only for GMTCK but for GM, I see this as a meaningful program that must continue to be advanced through close collaboration with global teams.

questions.aEn:
The ECS (Energy Conversion Systems) team designs and develops the core energy conversion components that serve as the “heart” of the vehicle. Specifically, we are responsible for engines, transmissions, exhaust systems, and various sensors in internal combustion engine vehicles, as well as motors, inverters, battery systems, and drive units for electric and hybrid vehicles. Because these components directly affect acceleration performance, efficiency, driving feel, and reliability, our role goes beyond designing individual parts—we develop the key systems that determine the overall performance of the vehicle.

Within this, I am responsible for motor design. My work is not limited to designing the motor structure itself; I take a holistic vehicle-level view, considering efficiency, durability, noise and vibration, cost, and manufacturability in an integrated way throughout the design process.

questions.a: 모터 설계를 위해서는 먼저 이론적 기반이 중요하다고 생각합니다. 전자기학 이론을 바탕으로 동기모터(PSM), 유도전동기(IM) 등 각 모터의 구조와 동작 원리를 이해해야 하며, 설계 단계에서는 해석 및 각종 도구를 활용하는 역량이 필요합니다. 각종 해석을 통해 자속 밀도, 토크 리플, 손실, 온도 분포, 진동·소음 특성을 예측하고, 슬롯·극수, 권선, 자석 형상 등 주요 설계 변수를 최적화해야 합니다. 또한 DFMEA, DV/PV, SOR, 도면, 품질 규격 등 GM 차량 개발 프로세스를 이해하고 이를 설계에 반영함으로써 양산 단계에서 발생할 수 있는 문제를 사전에 예방해야 합니다. 아울러 모터는 인버터, 제조, 차량팀과 긴밀히 연계되어 있으므로 각 분야의 요구사항을 이해하고 조율할 수 있는 커뮤니케이션 및 협업 능력 역시 필수적인 역량이라고 생각합니다.

questions.aEn:
For motor design, I believe having a solid theoretical foundation is crucial. You need to understand the structure and operating principles of different motor types—such as permanent magnet synchronous motors (PSM) and induction motors (IM)—based on electromagnetic theory, and be able to use various analysis methods and tools during the design phase. Through these analyses, you must predict flux density, torque ripple, losses, temperature distribution, and vibration/noise characteristics, and then optimize key design parameters such as slot/pole combinations, winding, and magnet geometry.

It is also important to understand GM’s vehicle development processes—such as DFMEA, DV/PV, SOR, drawings, and quality standards—and reflect them in the design to proactively prevent issues that may arise at the mass production stage. In addition, because motors are closely linked with inverters, manufacturing, and vehicle teams, strong communication and collaboration skills are essential to understand and align the requirements of each area.

questions.a:
GM의 In-house 소프트웨어 개발 확대에 따라 SW 관련 조직이 성장하면서, 개발되는 다양한 SW 기능과 서비스의 일정을 관리하고 있습니다. 각 기능은 서로 다른 개발 일정과 계획을 가지기 때문에, 차량 요구사항에 맞춰 타이밍을 조율함으로써 차량 내 SW가 적기에 적용될 수 있도록 업무를 수행합니다. 또한, 우리나라 마켓에서 필요로 하는 앱을 개발하며, Super Cruise가 국내에 적용될 수 있게 노력하였고, 다양한 콘텐츠 적용을 위해 노력하고 있습니다. Compute PM 역할로 Computing 모듈, ADAS와 텔레메틱스 관련된 SW 적용 계획과 이슈 대응을 DRE, SW 개발자, 프로그램 팀과 논의하며 차량 양산을 지원했습니다. 차량에 들어가는 SW 개발 기능 적용 시점과 차량 시험 및 반영 일정을 조율하며, 차량 개발 일정에 맞춘 SW 관리 업무를 수행했습니다.

현재는 차량 개발 프로젝트의 PM 역할을 맡아, 제품 로드맵에 기반하여 차량 개발 초기 단계부터 프로그램 팀과 협업해 적용 대상 SW 기능을 정의하고 있습니다. 또한 SW 개발을 위한 이니셔티브와 개발 역량을 검토하며, 차량 SW 적용에 필요한 비용과 리소스를 확인하고 차량 특성에 맞는 기능 반영을 조율하고 있습니다.

questions.aEn:
As GM expands its in-house software development, software-related organizations have been growing, and I manage the schedules of the various software features and services being developed. Since each feature has its own development timeline and plan, my role is to coordinate their timing against vehicle requirements so that in-vehicle software can be applied at the right moment.

We also develop apps tailored to the Korean market, and I have worked to enable the introduction of Super Cruise domestically, as well as to support the application of a wide range of content. In my previous role as a Compute PM, I supported vehicle launch by working with DREs, software developers, and program teams to plan software deployment and handle issues related to computing modules, ADAS, and telematics. I coordinated the timing of software feature deployment, vehicle testing, and implementation to ensure software was managed in line with the overall vehicle development schedule.

Currently, I serve as a PM for vehicle development projects, defining the software features to be applied from the early stages of vehicle development in collaboration with the program team, based on the product roadmap. I also review initiatives and development capabilities for software development, confirm the costs and resources required for in-vehicle software, and coordinate the integration of features that best fit the characteristics of each vehicle.

questions.aEn: A2LL. But precisely because there was so much to learn and such a strong sense of achievement in solving those challenges, it remains one of the projects that has left the deepest impression on me.

MAEC 담당은 Mechatronic & Sensing Hardware / ADAS & Embedded Controls 조직으로, GM 차량의 전기·전자(E/E) 아키텍처와 바디·편의 전장 시스템을 개발하고, 소프트웨어 정의 차량(SDV) 기능을 인하우스로 설계·검증하는 역할을 합니다.

The MAEC organization consists of the Mechatronic & Sensing Hardware and ADAS & Embedded Controls teams and is responsible for developing the electrical/electronic (E/E) architecture and body/convenience electrical systems for GM vehicles, as well as designing and validating software-defined vehicle (SDV) functions in-house. Within this organization, I was responsible for the Body Control Module (BCM), which controls lamps, wipers, door locks, and various convenience features, and I work on software and calibration development for body control functions based on SDV 2.0. You can think of the BCM as an electronic control unit that ties together electrical devices throughout the vehicle and manages the overall user experience (UX) for the driver and passengers.

My main responsibilities include tailoring the globally defined E/E architecture and software requirements to specific development vehicles, defining the development direction for BCM software and calibration, and tracking, analyzing, and resolving issues from test benches and vehicles using PRTS and Jira. I work closely with testing, manufacturing, and quality teams to ensure the final product’s completeness and overall customer experience.

questions.qEn: Please tell us your typical workday.
questions.a:
하루는 보통 전날 시험 결과와 PRTS/Jira 현황을 확인하는 것으로 시작합니다. 이후 그날 처리할 업무의 우선순위를 정리하고, 관련 팀과 원인 분석 및 대책 방향을 논의합니다.

일과 중에는 BCM 관련 새로운 요구사항·스펙 검토, 팀 미팅을 통한 이슈 공유 및 유사 차종·프로그램으로의 전파(read across) 논의, HW/SW/캘리브레이션 데이터 리뷰 및 릴리즈 결정, 부평 테크센터·청라 프로빙그라운드 시험 지원, 글로벌 팀과의 온라인 미팅으로 이슈 정리 및 다음 액션 결정 등을 합니다. 로그와 테스트 결과 검토 시 AI 기반 분석 도구도 활용해 개발 효율을 높이려 합니다.

마지막에 해결·미해결 이슈를 다시 점검하고, 향후 SW 릴리즈 일정과 리스크를 보며 다음 날 할 일을 정리합니다. 프로그램 일정 안에서 안정적인 품질을 확보하는 것이 하루의 핵심 목표입니다.

questions.aEn:
My day usually starts with reviewing the previous day’s test results and checking the current PRTS/Jira status. I then prioritize the tasks to be handled that day and discuss root-cause analysis and countermeasures with the relevant teams.

During the day, I review new BCM-related requirements and specifications, share issues in team meetings and discuss read-across to similar vehicle lines and programs, review and approve HW/SW/calibration data releases, support testing at the Bupyeong Tech Center and the Cheongna Proving Ground, and join online meetings with global teams to summarize issues and agree on next actions. When reviewing logs and test results, I also use AI-based analysis tools to improve development efficiency.

At the end of the day, I go back over resolved and unresolved issues, check upcoming software release schedules and risks, and organize the tasks for the next day. Within the overall program timeline, securing stable quality is the core goal of my daily work.

questions.a: 시스템·제품 이해력과 UX 관점: 하드웨어, 소프트웨어, 네트워크, 차량 기능이 어떻게 연결되는지 이해하고, 최종적으로 운전자·탑승자 UX에 어떤 영향을 주는지까지 보는 능력이 필요합니다. 데이터·AI 기반 문제 해결: 로그·계측·테스트 결과로 가설을 세우고 검증하며 근본 원인에 접근하는 능력, 여기에 AI 도구로 분석 효율을 높이는 능력이 점점 중요해집니다. 인하우스 개발 역량: SDV2.0에서는 외주가 아닌 내부에서 SW와 캘리브레이션을 설계·개선할 수 있는 역량이 필요합니다. 글로벌 커뮤니케이션: 북미·글로벌 팀과 일이 많아 영문 기술 커뮤니케이션과 네트워크로 문제를 함께 푸는 역량이 중요합니다. 이런 역량을 바탕으로 차량이 더 소프트웨어 중심으로 진화하는 흐름 속에서 함께 성장할 수 있는 직무라고 생각합니다.

For this role, it is important to have a strong understanding of systems and products from a UX perspective, meaning you can see how hardware, software, networks, and vehicle functions are connected and how they ultimately affect the driver and passenger experience.

You also need data- and AI-driven problem-solving skills: the ability to form and test hypotheses using logs, measurements, and test results to get to the root cause, while leveraging AI tools to improve analysis efficiency.

Under SDV 2.0, in-house development capability is essential, so we need people who can design and refine software and calibration internally rather than relying on outsourcing.

Because we work closely with North American and global teams, strong English technical communication skills and the ability to solve problems collaboratively through global networks are also critical. With these capabilities, I believe this role offers the opportunity to grow together with the broader industry trend of vehicles becoming increasingly software centric.

questions.aEn:
The recent Bolt program. It was a highly challenging project in which we had to dramatically shorten the traditional development timeline while refusing to compromise on quality. Rather than simply following the existing framework, we redesigned our development methods and processes while still preserving the core fundamentals.

We compensated for the shortened schedule by shifting from physical vehicle checks to virtual development, and we added extra verification as well. By incorporating automated development methods, we were able to reduce time and demonstrate that it is possible to secure the required quality and performance without relying solely on physical vehicles and testing.

Going through the VeSCoM process, I saw the capabilities of each SWQnD team member really come to life, and it was a valuable experience that made me once again appreciate their potential.

SW/Cal.을 차량에서 확인하며 나오는 이슈를 더 빨리 찾아 반영하기 위해 어떤 프로세스가 도움이 될지 브레인스토밍하기도 합니다. SW common으로 한 프로그램만의 문제가 아니라 다른 프로그램에 영향을 줄 수 있어 크로스 체크와 정보 공유가 중요해지고 있습니다. 각 프로그램에서 얻은 경험과 교훈을 적극 공유하며 실질적으로 도움을 주고받는 문화를 만들어 가고 있습니다.

questions.aEn: Our biggest strength is that we have a group of veterans with deep experience and expertise. Each team member is responsible for one or more programs and works with a high level of technical capability and ownership built over many years. There is a culture of trusting and respecting one another’s expertise. As the vehicle development environment changes rapidly, we are constantly looking for smarter ways to work, for example, brainstorming what processes would help us detect and feedback SW/Cal-related issues from vehicles more quickly. Because software is common across programs, a problem in one program can affect others, so cross-checking and information sharing are becoming increasingly important. We actively share the lessons and experiences gained from each program and build a culture where this exchange provides real, practical help to one another.

questions.aEn: In the short term, my goal is to further improve SW/Cal. quality and schedule stability on the programs I’m responsible for, and to advance the VeSCoM-based software release and deployment process so that it becomes a best practice for delivering high vehicle-level quality. Based on the experience I gain along the way, I hope to mentor junior colleagues, elevate the overall capability of the team, and grow as a leader who contributes to spreading a culture of diversity and inclusion within the organization.
